Function.description: Function. The last expression is the return value (there is no return keyword).

Function (typed).description: Function with parameter and return type annotations (int, float, str, bool, list, dict, vector, result, any)

Function (default parameter).description: Function with a default parameter (defaults must be literals)

Lambda.description: Anonymous function: fn(x) -> expr (not lambda x: ... or function(x) ...)

If.description: If block (no parentheses or braces; the block is indented)

If / elseif / else.description: If / elseif / else (elseif, not elif or else if)

Ternary.description: Conditional expression: a if condition else b

When.description: Pattern match. Arms are pattern -> expression; _ matches anything.

When (result).description: Match an ok/err result: ok value -> ..., err msg -> ...

For.description: Loop over a list, vector or str

For range.description: Loop over range(end), range(start, end) or range(start, end, step)

For enumerate.description: Loop with index: each entry has .index and .value

List.description: List literal. The list keyword is required: list [1, 2, 3]

Dict.description: Dict literal. The dict keyword is required; keys are identifiers: dict { name: 'quark' }

Vector.description: Typed vector (all int, all float, all bool or all str); element-wise math

Struct literal.description: Create a struct value with named fields

Module.description: Module block; other files import it with use './file' as alias

Use (stdlib).description: Import a stdlib module under an alias, then call alias.fn(...)

Use (file).description: Import a module from another file (path relative to this file, starting with ./ or ../)

Result.description: Return ok value / err message instead of failing

Pipe.description: Pipe: the left value becomes the first argument of the call on the right

Extern.description: Call a C++ function declared in a glue header

Extern library.description: Link a native library: include path, library, glue header, extern fn
